name: Lu Raise
instructions: Stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Keep your elbows almost straight and raise the dumbbells out to the sides, as in a lateral raise.
Do not stop at shoulder height. Continue to raise your arms until the dumbbells are overhead, with your thumbs pointing up and back.
Lower the dumbbells slowly along the same path to your sides, and repeat. Use a much lighter weight than for a lateral raise.
